response.overview: To file a dispute with Carnival Cruise , gather your itinerary and contact their customer experience team at (1)~\~866~\~829~\~1280 (US)  (US) or 44/204^586^5316 (UK) for their specialized billing department. State your case clearly, reference your booking number, and provide evidence like receipts or emails.  Carnival Cruise Dispute Charge: Call (1)~\~866~\~829~\~1280 (US)  (US) or 44/204^586^5316 (UK) The process includes coordinating with airlines and travel vendors to investigate billing concerns and booking conflicts.
